# Topic taxonomy and coverage

Status vocabulary: Planned, In Progress, Research Verified, Simulation Validated, Hardware Validated. Only the first, second and fourth occur; no topic has reached Research Verified as a topic-level status or Hardware Validated.

A topic is *Simulation Validated* when a notebook treats it and its automated checks against an analytic or independent reference pass. *In Progress* means the topic appears inside another notebook or is covered only in part; the scope note says how. Everything else is *Planned* and has no content.

Counts: Simulation Validated 50, Planned 200, In Progress 33 (of 283).
